description: Software testing checks whether a program behaves as expected. We will use tiny examples to practise choosing inputs, checking results and explaining bugs. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain empty input is a real case
learningObjectives: Practise make a bug report useful

seo.title: Software Testing Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Software Testing with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
